reasoning: The question asks whether the Russia-Ukraine war will still be ongoing on March 18, 2026 (the 12th anniversary of Crimea's annexation). As of the forecast date (March 6, 2026), the war is clearly still active. Evidence shows ongoing combat, failed peace negotiations as of early March 2026, and no ceasefire agreement. Multiple sources confirm the war entered its fifth year on February 24, 2026, with a military stalemate persisting. Peace talks involving Trump have failed to resolve core disagreements over territory and security guarantees. The war has evolved into a protracted conflict with no imminent resolution visible. Only 12 days separate the forecast date from March 18, 2026, making it highly unlikely the war would suddenly end in that timeframe given the current stalemate and failed diplomatic efforts.
